rootCause: PoE-style fixtures can be electrically routed without proving IEEE PoE compliance, magnetics, isolation, sourcing, or stock.
fix: BoardForge may use a PoE electrical workflow fixture as routing/manufacturing evidence only when it carries explicit honesty badges: POE_COMPLIANCE_NOT_VERIFIED, MAGNETICS_NOT_VERIFIED, ISOLATION_NOT_VERIFIED, and SOURCING_NOT_API_VERIFIED.
